chapter: Booker T, the brass bands and the Pelican band
title: Booker T, the oldest Odd Fellow, from dance drummer to bass drum
summary: Dawson recalls the drummer Booker T, about ninety, who played snare and bass drum in dance bands before becoming famous in the brass bands.
